result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue found in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' restaurant cards appear side by side in the 'Fastest near you' carousel with the same delivery time (15–25 min) and price (€0.90 delivery). This looks like a duplicate data rendering bug rather than intentional content.
issues.suggestion: Investigate the data source feeding the 'Fastest near you' section to ensure deduplication logic is applied, preventing the same restaurant from appearing multiple times in the same carousel.
